content_sections.text: Out of the 27 Veterinary Assistant posts, 1 post is reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwD), that is, locomotor disability including cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, acid attack victims and muscular dystrophy.

faq.question: Q1. What is GSSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Goa Staff Selection Commission (GSSC) has invited online applications for Group 'C' posts of Food Safety Officer and Veterinary Assistant in various Government Departments of Government of Goa, through Advertisement No. 4 of Year 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in GSSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 posts of Food Safety Officer and 27 posts of Veterinary Assistant, 32 in total. The Commission states that these vacancies are tentative.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for GSSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to fill up the online application is 30/10/2026.

faq.question: Q4. When will the GSSC online application start?
faq.answer: The portal to submit online applications will be available by 09/10/2026. An exact start date is not specified.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for GSSC Food Safety Officer and Veterinary Assistant?
faq.answer: It is not specified in the brief advertisement. Refer to the detailed advertisement to be uploaded by 09/10/2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for GSSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process is not specified. The examination date will be intimated through the Commission's website and the local daily.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for GSSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through https://gssc.goa.gov.in after reading the "Instructions" on the website. Applications through any other mode will not be accepted.
